---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for socketio-rs
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

**Problem Statement**
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

**Proposed Solution**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Alternative Approaches Considered**
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

**Target Component**
- [ ] `engineio-core` (transport, drivers, low-level protocol)
- [ ] `socketio-parser` (codecs, SIMD, binary attachments)
- [ ] `socketio-server` (namespaces, rooms, acks, extractors)
- [ ] `socketio-adapters` (Redis, NATS, Postgres, CSR)
- [ ] `socketio-gateway` (sidecar binary, control API, webhooks)
- [ ] `sio-migrate-cli` (migration tooling)

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, benchmarks, or reference RFCs here.
